sahneler.metin: A brand-new dam above Sheffield burst at night.
The flood swept through the valley, killing about two hundred forty people.
The reservoir was filling for the first time.
Hours earlier, a worker spotted a crack in the embankment.
It was judged not to be urgent.
Water broke through and tore the dam open.
It was one of Britain's worst dam disasters.
It influenced later reservoir safety laws in Britain.

aciklama:
Sheffield flood burst as its reservoir filled for the first time. The cause: embankment failure likely linked to its clay core and construction on first filling.
